title: STM32 Audio Processor
description: A low-latency digital effects processor utilising the DSP core of the STM32F4, featuring an intuitive user interface and real-time processing.
materials:
• Core: STM32F4 Discovery Board
• Audio Interface: External DAC via I2S protocol
• Algorithms: Real-time Reverb and Delay filters
• Buffering: DMA-assisted circular buffers for zero-jitter audio flow
results: Achieved stable audio processing with latency under 10ms. The software architecture successfully separates UI processing from high-priority audio tasks using DMA interrupts.
